codes_source.policy: Fewest matching species worldwide across official common-name and banding codes; prefer banding on ties, then alphabetical order. All candidates are accepted. Scientific codes excluded.

exceptions.spofly1: Retained v2025 species concept; v2026 reclassifies this ID as a slash (Muscicapa striata/tyrrhenica). Codes remain from the official 2025 workbook pending a taxonomy migration.
